raw_files.path: raw/papers/2019_Chen et al_Transverse wobbling in an even-even nucleus.pdf

covered_sections: PDF 1–2: prior GALILEO observations, four-angle delta table, conditional branch and rotor input
PDF 3–5: ratio and geometry model comparison, limits and bibliography
evidence_gaps: The smaller absolute-delta branches have smaller chi-square; the larger branches cannot be excluded by these angular distributions alone.
I=19 and 21 have adopted delta of -0.60 with no printed uncertainty. No quantitative P.

covered_sections: Main PDF 1–3: spectroscopy, gated level scheme and angular extraction overview
Main PDF 4–7: deformation/configuration systematics and comparisons
Official SI PDF 1–4: D1 and t-band rates, S-band gated spectra, band parameters and model plots
evidence_gaps: No experimental P or numerical sigma/I for S1 prime links. SI rates apply to D1/t-band; support for S1 prime includes gate spectra.

covered_sections: PDF 1–2: PSM motivation, pairing, projection and basis
PDF 3–5: compared S bands, electromagnetic ratios, azimuth/K distributions and references
evidence_gaps: No new photons or polarization observations. Possible critical spin near I=23 is a model result.

shared_experiment_dependency: Petrache GALILEO 122Sn(13C,5n)130Ba at 65 MeV supplies the experimental lineage; Chen and Wang reuse it and use different models.
